introHtml: RFID-blocking health products combine the functionality of wellness items like wristbands, lanyards, or badge holders with the security of shielding against electronic pickpocketing. For safety managers and HR directors equipping employees at trade shows or daily commutes, these items protect sensitive data from credit cards and access badges while promoting your brand. Choose from silicone wristbands with embedded blocking material or nylon lanyards with RFID-safe pockets for a practical giveaway that prioritizes both health and identity protection.
